content: सान्तानिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Stretching, spreading, extending (as a tree). .²2 Relating to offspring or descendants. .²3 Relating to the tree Santāna, <ab>q. v.</ab> .²4 Desirous of offspring; नाहं त्वां भस्मसात् कुर्यां स्त्रियं सान्तानिकः सति <ls>Bhāg. 9. 14. 9</ls>. .²5 Desirous of marriage; <ls>Ms. 11. 1</ls> (<ab>com.</ab>). .{@-कः@} .²1 A Brāhmaṇa who wishes to marry for the sake of issue. .²2 (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of particular worlds.
